primary_task: Automatically reconstruct experiment-level dataset provenance from public artifacts and determine DM-H01 applicability when a mechanically reproducible reference is available.
gold_admission_policy: Artifact-grounded only: public/version-pinned artifacts plus deterministic issue contract; no domain judgment outside the contract.
silver_label_policy: Heuristic/structured-metadata/LLM labels may be used for training or development only and are never promoted to gold by confidence alone.
candidate_frame: DermaMNIST downstream-use references 41-64 from the primary issue investigation; author-selected frame, not field-representative
sampling_rule: Sort unique normalized study keys by SHA-256 of MDT-P0-20260913|study-key; first six; no replacement for difficult/non-gold cases.
budget_status: Proposed calibration caps, not observed durations or completion promises
notes: Do not claim expert validation, user benefit, or gold correctness unless supported by the corresponding evidence tier.
